title: Nurse between shifts, has to run
scenario: ER nurse interested in a first home purchase answers between shifts and has to cut the call short. Rep gets minimal discovery and books a callback.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi, is this Marisol? It's Gideon with Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, hi. Sorry, I've got like two minutes.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: No problem, I'll be brief. You were interested in buying your first place?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah. I've been renting forever and I'm sick of it.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I hear you. Are you working full time right now?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, I'm an ER nurse. Three twelves a week, plus some overtime.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Great, that's helpful. Do you know roughly where your credit is?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Somewhere in the seven hundreds, I think. Oh, shoot, they're paging me. I have to run, call me later?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Of course. What's a better time?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I don't know, I'm off Saturday.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Perfect. I'll call you then. Go save some lives.
